revision: Before scientific outputs, preserved v1 prefix-cap files and v2 snippet files in separate whole-file archives. v3 deterministically merges two different query windows for a duplicate point within the shared 800-character cap. Existing retained live corpus is reused. Before outcomes, preserved the initial v3 source/protocol in before_json_schema_v3, then added explicitly declared nested JSON structural schemas for two source-audited array fields; no enum, const, examples, descriptions or hidden gold values are permitted.
artifact_namespace: _matched_retrieval_v1 is the existing new-only storage namespace; method version is v3.
state: method fixed; source-only task selection must be separately frozen before generation
setup_probe: Root reports one successful CLI setup probe separately; not a scientific task outcome or part of study cap.
retry_policy: No automatic trial retries. Failed/time-limited/tool-using trials retained with empty prediction in fixed denominator.
call_cap_unit: CLI invocations, reserved durably before launch. CLI internal provider retries are not observable. Retrieval cap 180 plus root's separate KG cap 40 totals <=220 CLI invocations.

retrieval.corpus: all 25 existing WG-scoped Qdrant text collections via payload-only scroll; separate SQLite shard per WG
retrieval.query_tokens: Unicode alphanumeric words length >=2; fixed short English stoplist; unique first 64 terms with OR
retrieval.merge: Reciprocal rank fusion k=60; source identity (collection, point_id); stable lexical tie breaks
retrieval.duplicate_point_passages: Identical snippets appear once. Two different query windows are kept in retrieval-round order, initially receive equal character budgets (397/398 plus five-character separator), and deterministically reuse the other window's unused budget. Combined text never exceeds 800 characters.
retrieval.passage_selection: SQLite FTS5 snippet of <=64 tokens around query matches, then <=800-character cap; replaces historical leading-prefix truncation before outcomes.
retrieval.document_header: Collection/point/chunk identity plus existing source metadata specNumber/trNumber/tdocNumber/section/sectionNumber. Header is separate from the 800-character text cap and identical for both retrieval arms.
retrieval.historical_difference: New SQLite BM25 tokenizer/index/scoring replaces unavailable historical bm25s/Lucene artifacts. Not a reconstruction of prior BM25 results.

reader.output: records of named typed fields plus abstain boolean
reader.total_compute: Iterative arm adds one helper generation; report total usage and helper cost separately. Not total-cost matched.
reader.temperature_and_token_limits: CLI does not expose verified historical API temperature=0/max_tokens=1200 equivalence; do not claim that equivalence or exact historical KG reader matching.
reader.tool_policy: Tools forbidden in prompt; any actual event describing a tool action invalidates that trial. No gold or reference query is supplied.
reader.system_prompt_visibility: The complete built-in CLI system prompt is not exposed in captured output and is unrecorded. Shared invocation between arms does not certify absence of all hidden system context.
reader.abstain_limit: Operational empty prediction signal only; not a validated abstention benchmark.
reader.json_fields: JSON-typed fields require explicit structural json_schema containing only types, declared properties/items/required/additionalProperties=false and optional explicit array bounds. Nested values are strictly validated; no enum/const/example/description hints.

resources.cli_slots: Two flock-protected slots shared across retrieval/KG processes

preservation: New-only namespace. Completed snapshot/task/call/prediction records use exclusive creation. Historical manuscript, closed responses, and public bytes untouched.
scientific_bounds: A bounded two-round follow-up-query adaptation, not full IRCoT or Iter-RetGen reproduction and not a new method claim.
Task subset selected from source/question/contract criteria before new model outputs; not the full Core 560 run.
Existing answer-column diagnostic key and AI review do not become expert-validated semantic canonical truth.
Qdrant scroll is non-atomic. Start/end exact counts detect count changes but not same-count edits; both arms use one retained local corpus.
Live Qdrant source cutoff is not asserted to match the original DOI TTL graph; cross-representation source equality remains unverified.
Independent expert validation, broader domains, and historical original-table reconstruction remain separate outstanding issues.
